messages:
Dylan: heads up — canary run of int8-llama-adapter is returning malformed funcall JSONs when requests pass through schema-adaptor gateway. Repro on ~30% of calls :eyes:
Maya: any logs or an example payload?
Dylan: here's a failing snippet from the gateway logs:
```
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "tokenizer",},}

ParseError: Unexpected token '}' at position 42
```
Priya: CI dashboard shows toolcall-json-schema-tests 12/200 failing, majority are parse errors like that. Pattern looks like trailing commas and stripped backslashes in escaped strings.
Alex: hmm. Could be quantized model output adding stray commas? but more likely the gateway is doing a streaming pretty-print and mutating partial chunks. We've seen streaming-formatters introduce commas at boundaries.
Priya: hypothesis: rate limiter/batching cuts streaming at buffer boundary -> schema-adaptor runs a "format" pass on partial chunk, inserts punctuation, then final chunk arrives -> invalid JSON. Also probable that the gateway is un-escaping and re-escaping quotes incorrectly.
Eva: quick repro idea: run a small loop hitting canary with deliberately long tool args to force chunking, then cat raw stream and compare to after-adaptor stream. I'll spin it up.
ci-bot: toolcall-json-schema-tests started (run id: 20260320-3) — currently 188 passed / 12 failed
Maya: low-effort hotfix: bypass pretty-printing in schema-adaptor for any request with "x-streamed: true" header or when model profile says `streaming_chunking=true`. That avoids mid-stream formatting.
Alex: better: adaptor should buffer until it sees final closing brace or receives runtime `is_final=true` flag. Buffering a few KB shouldn't impact latency for these calls. For canary we can flip bypass first.
Priya: agreed. I'll file an issue and add a canary patch: set `schema_adaptor.bypass_for_models: ["int8-llama-adapter-canary"]` and add tests for escaped sequences.
Dylan: also add a retry cadence tweak — if parse fails, don't immediately retry fast. We had hammering where retry+rate-limit made adaptor drop the tail. Exponential backoff 300ms -> 1s should be fine.
Eva: opened PR #4214: "schema-adaptor: bypass pretty-print for streamed toolcalls + add parse-safety buffer". Included unit test demonstrating trailing-comma case and an e2e against canary.
ci-bot: PR #4214 CI: failing — flaky snapshot due to ordering in pretty-print tests (expected).
Maya: looks good, can we also add a test that simulates rate-limiter-induced mid-stream cut? That's the core failure mode.
Priya: added test in #4214, rerunning CI. Also added an eval harness run: 5k toolcall samples against canary before/after. Results: pre-fix 30% parse errors; post-fix 0.4% (mostly timeouts). Full report attached to the PR.
ci-bot: toolcall-json-schema-tests rerun: 200/200 passed ✅
Alex: nice. Follow-up: we should add a small telemetry metric `schema_adaptor.formatting_drops` to catch regressions.
Dylan: opened GH issue for telemetry and rollout plan. Plan: hotfix canary, monitor 24h, then ship to dedicated. Assigning Priya to lead rollout.
Priya: on it. Will also add a short note in the onboarding checklist for new models: "if streaming toolcalls are used, validate raw stream -> adaptor output parity".
Maya: perfect. :thumbsup:
